purpose: Remove reference-only UE4 controls introduced by generation and preserve real Quader control content
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted functional cleanup only. Image 1 is the new Quader mockup to edit; Image 2 is the user's actual Quader UI for control contents. Preserve Image 1's exact early-UE4-inspired sculpted charcoal styling, shaped dock tabs, bevels, palette, typography, all panel sizes and placement, viewport scene, texture canvas, selected geometry and all other details.
Make only these corrections:
1. Remove the extra toolbar FLOATING INSIDE the viewport at its upper-left that says "Perspective", "Lit", "Show" and has three small buttons. It was borrowed from the style reference and is not in Quader. Reconstruct the black/grid scene behind it.
2. In the fixed narrow viewport control strip directly above the scene, retain Environment / Perspective / Shaded controls at the far right. Use the empty strip on the left for Quader's actual selection, move, rotate, scale and snapping icon cluster as shown in Image 2, redrawn in the SAME small pictorial sculpted icon style as Image 1. Do not add labels or new functions.
3. Remove the invented Search input row directly beneath the Outliner title tab and move the existing tree rows upward to occupy that space. Keep the tree content unchanged.
Change nothing else. Do not flatten or modernize the visual style. Do not change the scene. No extra controls, no added text, no cinematic polish.
